name: univer
description: The Office Harness for AI Agents — Spreadsheets, Docs, Slides, Canvas, Relational Tables, and PDF in one runtime.
one_liner: A toolkit developers can drop into their own app to add real spreadsheets, documents, and slides that behave like Excel and Google Docs, without licensing Microsoft or Google.
buyer: A vertical-SaaS founder (construction quoting, clinic billing, property management) who needs a real spreadsheet or document editor inside their product but can't afford to build one from scratch.
business_use_cases: A construction-estimating SaaS embeds a live spreadsheet grid for quotes so customers can use familiar formulas instead of a clunky custom table.
A legal-tech startup embeds a Word-like document editor for contract drafting directly in its web app, avoiding a fragile Google Docs iframe.
An agency builds white-label internal tools (budgets, trackers, report decks) for clients on one shared office engine instead of separate libraries per format.

money_ideas.idea: Charge implementation fees to embed a branded spreadsheet/doc editor into a client's existing product.
Build a niche embeddable widget (e.g. a budget planner) on top of it and charge monthly per workspace.

steal_this: Build a single embeddable 'quote sheet' widget with PDF export and sell it this weekend to one local trade business currently emailing Excel files back and forth.
